airport.name: La Rochelle Île de Ré Airport

summary: La Rochelle Île de Ré Airport serves the historic port city of La Rochelle on France's Atlantic coast, providing convenient access to the popular Île de Ré and the Charente-Maritime region. The airport is a regional hub offering primarily seasonal and year-round European connections, particularly to the UK. Its compact size makes it one of the most accessible gateways to western France's coastal attractions.
faqs:
Q: How far is La Rochelle Île de Ré Airport from the city center?
A: The airport is located approximately 5 km (3 miles) northeast of La Rochelle's historic center, with a typical taxi or bus ride taking around 15-20 minutes.

Q: Which airlines operate from La Rochelle Airport?
A: The airport is served by a mix of low-cost carriers and regional airlines, including flights operated by Ryanair and easyJet, with most routes being seasonal though some operate year-round to destinations like London and Paris.

Q: Is there public transportation available to the airport?
A: Yes, local bus line 1 connects the airport with central La Rochelle, and taxis are readily available outside the terminal for the short journey into town.

Q: Does the airport have car parking facilities?
A: The airport offers on-site parking with both short-stay and long-stay options available close to the terminal building.
transport_tips: A taxi from the airport to central La Rochelle typically costs around 15-20 euros and is the most convenient option, especially with luggage. The local bus service provides a budget-friendly alternative, though schedules may be limited on Sundays and holidays. Renting a car at the airport is highly recommended if you plan to explore the Île de Ré or drive along the Atlantic coast.
local_tip: If you have a few hours before your flight, visit the Vieux Port just a short taxi ride from the airport to see La Rochelle's iconic medieval towers and grab fresh oysters at the morning market—locals swear this is the best way to taste the region's maritime heritage.
